rationale.consistency: Uses slices/maps idioms already present in the package, keeps the options-map keyed-by-string convention, and mirrors existing existingVal-style option chaining; gofmt-style code.
rationale.edge_cases: Handles nil options, first vs chained order lines via existingVal, invalid order (error, nothing leaks since options is a local clone), plugin RegisterDirectiveOrder aliasing bug fixed via Clone before Insert.
rationale.scope: Focused on order isolation; cloning the entire options map and deleting a caller-supplied 'order' key are slightly broader than required but justified by the reuse requirement. RegisterDirectiveOrder rewrite fixes real aliasing.
rationale.readability: directiveOrderFor is a clear seam; comments explain the why. Threading order through buildSubroute is explicit. Comments are a little wordy but not excessive.
rationale.robustness: No shared mutable order state at adaptation time; process-wide order only mutated at init; parseOptOrder clones before DeleteFunc/Insert; no locks needed; no panic paths on bad input beyond existing init-time panics.
rationale.maintainability: Order flows via a parameter rather than a global, so future callers must be explicit. Implicit contract that options['order'] is []string is documented but stringly-typed; directiveOrderFor(h.options) repeated at three call sites.
